about: The bodies owned by the Algarve's 16 councils that buy under their own NIF, so their contracts are not in the councils' own totals on BASE. Companies from DGAL's list of local companies; NIFs as IMPIC's open data publishes each buyer, cross-checked with Diário da República notices or the company's site where noted. Councils with none in DGAL's list: Albufeira, Alcoutim, Aljezur, Castro Marim, Lagoa, Monchique, São Brás de Alportel, Silves, Vila do Bispo.
by: civic.b.research.companies@PrompTugal.dinis (Sonnet), checked against IMPIC's open data by civic.b@PrompTugal.dinis

sources.title: DGAL, Lista das empresas locais (xlsx, dated 12 February 2025)
IMPIC open data of the Portal BASE on dados.gov.pt

gaps: EMPET's NIF was not found: it has no contract on BASE in 2025 or 2026 and DGAL marks it without activity or in liquidation.
Portimão Urbis is not in DGAL's list.
Council shares are DGAL's 'Participação' column where the researcher noted them; others not recorded yet.
cm-faro.pt and cm-loule.pt reset the connection, so the councils' own pages on their companies were not read.
